muteOnEntry.label: Mute on entry
muteOnEntry.description: New joiners start with mic muted.

muteAll.label: Mute all
muteAll.description: Everyone but you — they can unmute themselves.

micNoiseFilter.description: Filters your microphone before it is transcribed. Changes how accurately your words are recognised — not what other people hear.

flashMode.label: Flash mode
flashMode.editable: Start translating while people are still speaking. Faster, and still experimental.
flashMode.room: Set by the host. Translation starts while people are still speaking.
flashMode.deployment: Following the platform default. Translation starts while people are still speaking.
flashMode.unknown: Not known right now — the room is using whatever the platform defaults to.

myLanguage.title: My language
myLanguage.hint: What you speak, and what everyone else is translated into for you.

otherLanguages.title: Other languages
otherLanguages.hint: Not offered by this room, but still translated for you.

micCheck.title: Mic check
micCheck.liveLevelAriaLabel: Live microphone level, as others hear it
micCheck.prompt: Say something — the bars are what others hear.
micCheck.off: Your microphone is off — unmute to check it.

background.noticeable: Background: noticeable — others can hear your room.
background.loud: Background: loud — check what your microphone is next to.
